notes.evidence_notice: Completed primary study: 896 attempts; 890 valid networks, including 12 empty; six failures retained separately. Six selectively completed supplements are excluded.
notes.calibration_note: Eight planned seeds per condition. Individual layers are descriptive; only the separate 24-test family supplies adjusted inference.
notes.limitations: One designed fictional adult roster. Country framing is a prompt condition, not a representative national population. Marginal attribute mixing does not isolate causal preferences.
notes.verification: All primary adjacency and local record hashes verified; recorded added/removed edges reconstruct all 890 final graphs. Replay loads on demand. No raw prompts, responses or credentials exported.
